# Turn a collections spreadsheet into a SEPA direct debit file

> Free CSV to SEPA direct debit converter: turn a spreadsheet of member or customer collections into a pain.008 XML file for your bank. Checks every IBAN, mandate and your creditor identifier first, groups FRST/RCUR/OOFF/FNAL batches, and never uploads your list.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
